data.one_liner: Customizable dropdown with search, multi‑select, and built‑in validation
data.what_it_does: Provides a single‑purpose dropdown widget that supports local and network search, multi‑selection, and form validation. It offers extensive styling and keyboard support out of the box.
use_when: You need a searchable dropdown for a list of items
You want multi‑select with checkboxes and a done button
You need form validation for a single‑select field
You want a lightweight widget with no external dependencies
avoid_when: You require complex custom animations that are not supported by the widget
You need a fully custom dropdown layout that cannot be achieved with the provided builders
strengths: Easy to use API with no controllers or builders required
Supports local and network search with debounce and error handling
Built‑in multi‑select with select‑all and done button
Full theming and styling support, including dark mode
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter; no web‑specific optimizations beyond standard Flutter web support
No support for very large lists that require virtualization
